Description: Respondent sequence number (unique participant identifier)
Harmonization Notes: Identical across all cycles.

Description: Age in years at screening (top-coded at 80 in E/F/G)
Harmonization Notes: Consistent across cycles. Top-coded at 80 years (80 = >=80 years).

Description: Gender of participant
Harmonization Notes: Binary 1=Male, 2=Female across all cycles.

Description: Race / Hispanic Origin (5-level standard classification)
Valid Range / Coding: 1=Mexican American, 2=Other Hispanic, 3=Non-Hispanic White, 4=Non-Hispanic Black, 5=Other Race / Multi-Racial
Harmonization Notes: Harmonized across 2007-2012. RIDRETH3 (with Asian) introduced in 2011; RIDRETH1 retained for 6-year compatibility.

Description: Full Sample 2-Year Mobile Examination Center (MEC) Exam Weight
Harmonization Notes: Per CDC guidelines, for a 3-cycle (6-year) pooled examination analysis: WTMEC6YR = WTMEC2YR / 3.

Description: Masked Variance Pseudo-Stratum for complex survey design
Harmonization Notes: Identical structure. Used with Taylor series linearization.

Description: Masked Variance Pseudo-Primary Sampling Unit (PSU)
Harmonization Notes: Identical structure across cycles.

Description: Standing Height in centimeters
Harmonization Notes: Consistent. Critical for GLI/Hankinson predicted spirometric lung volume calculation.

Description: Weight in kilograms
Harmonization Notes: Standard scale across cycles.

Description: Body Mass Index (BMI)
Harmonization Notes: Calculated as BMXWT / (BMXHT/100)^2.

Description: Smoked at least 100 cigarettes in lifetime
Harmonization Notes: Coding identical across cycles. Fundamental gateway to pack-years.

Description: Do you now smoke cigarettes?
Harmonization Notes: Combined with SMQ020 into 3-level smokingStatus: Never (SMQ020=2), Former (SMQ020=1 & SMQ040=3), Current (SMQ020=1 & SMQ040 in [1,2]).

Description: Age started smoking cigarettes regularly
Harmonization Notes: Used with age and cigarettes/day to compute cumulative pack-years.

Description: Number of cigarettes smoked per day on days smoked
Harmonization Notes: Harmonized across 2007-2012 (replaces older NHANES SMD070). Pack-years for current = (SMD650 / 20) * (RIDAGEYR - SMD030).

Description: Age last smoked cigarettes regularly (cessation age)
Harmonization Notes: Harmonized across Cycles E, F, G. Used with SMD030 to compute duration for former smokers: (SMD055 - SMD030).

Description: Number of cigarettes smoked per day when quit
Harmonization Notes: Harmonized across Cycles E, F, G. Used with SMD055 and SMD030 to compute pack-years: (SMD057 / 20) * (SMD055 - SMD030).

Description: Cough most days for >= 3 consecutive months of the year?
Harmonization Notes: Identical wording and binary coding across all three cycles.

Description: Bring up phlegm/sputum most days for >= 3 consecutive months?
Harmonization Notes: Identical coding across cycles.

Description: Wheezing or whistling in chest in past 12 months?
Harmonization Notes: Identical coding across cycles.

Description: Chest sound wheezy or whistling during or after exercise?
Harmonization Notes: Consistent. Note: administered only if wheezing reported or filter active.

Description: Ever been told by a doctor had asthma?
Harmonization Notes: Identical coding across cycles.

Description: Still have asthma?
Harmonization Notes: Structural skip pattern from MCQ010.

Description: Ever told had emphysema?
Harmonization Notes: Administered to adults >= 20 years across cycles.

Description: Ever told had chronic bronchitis?
Harmonization Notes: Administered to adults >= 20 years across cycles.

Description: Type of work done / Employment status in past week
Harmonization Notes: Check cycle consistency.

Description: Baseline Spirometry Examination Status Code
Harmonization Notes: Critical QC gateway: only SPXNSTAT=1 or 2 have spirometric curves.

Description: Baseline Pre-Bronchodilator Forced Vital Capacity (FVC)
Harmonization Notes: Reported in milliliters in SAS file. Must divide by 1000 to convert to Litres.

Description: Baseline Pre-Bronchodilator Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (FEV1)
Harmonization Notes: Reported in milliliters in SAS file. Must divide by 1000 to convert to Litres.

Description: Data Quality Grade for Baseline FVC (ATS/ERS 1994 Standards)
Role: Quality Control Filter (Strict A/B vs Expanded A/B/C)
Harmonization Notes: Grade A: >= 3 acceptable curves with <= 150ml variation. Grade B: <= 200ml variation. Grade C: <= 250ml variation.

Description: Data Quality Grade for Baseline FEV1
Role: Quality Control Filter (Strict A/B vs Expanded A/B/C)
Harmonization Notes: Grade A: >= 3 acceptable curves with <= 150ml variation in FEV1.

Description: Number of acceptable baseline pre-BD curves obtained
Harmonization Notes: >= 3 acceptable curves required for Grade A.

Description: Pre-BD examinee effort and repeatability evaluation
Harmonization Notes: Effort verification.

Description: Did participant receive inhaled bronchodilator (albuterol)?
Role: Post-BD Selection Indicator & Verification Bias Audit
Harmonization Notes: Critical: Post-BD test was NOT administered to all participants! Administered selectively to those with baseline obstruction or asthma history.

Description: Post-Bronchodilator Forced Vital Capacity (FVC)
Role: Secondary Confirmatory Outcome / Active Acquisition Target
Harmonization Notes: Convert ml to Litres (/ 1000). Highly non-random missingness (verification bias).

Description: Post-Bronchodilator Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (FEV1)
Role: Secondary Confirmatory Outcome / Active Acquisition Target
Harmonization Notes: Convert ml to Litres (/ 1000). Essential for distinguishing reversible asthma from fixed COPD.

Description: Data Quality Grade for Post-Bronchodilator FVC
Harmonization Notes: Post-BD quality threshold.

Description: Data Quality Grade for Post-Bronchodilator FEV1
Harmonization Notes: Post-BD quality threshold.
